metadata.dcterms:title: A version of the volume conjecture
metadata.dcterms:creator: MURAKAMI, HITOSHI
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We propose a version of the volume conjecture that would relate a certain limit of the colored Jones polynomials of a knot to the volume function deﬁned by a representation of the fundamental group of the knot complement to the special linear group of degree two over complex numbers. We also conﬁrm the conjecture for the ﬁgure-eight knot and torus knots. This version is diﬀerent from S. Gukov’s because of a choice of polarization.
